body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: Several broken flights of a modest dungeon stair adapted into shelter. Timber landings bridge missing steps; bedrolls and cooking pots fit its irregular geometry. People sit at different heights, mage at the unlit near turn. COMPOSITION: Stair turns sharply behind a thick support, people appear in two separated horizontal bands. COLOR SCRIPT: blue-black water, pale weathered timber, restrained turquoise, warm ivory light. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
